items.name: Port operational / passenger support building

distinguishingTraits: Alicante’s port has a strong east/west functional split: Levante city-facing areas support leisure, ferries and cruise/passenger uses, while commercial/operational activity is concentrated toward Poniente.
The cruise terminal at Muelle 14 is directly documented as a two-storey passenger building; this scale is not a template for freight or multipurpose terminals.
